description: Run a test in a real browser and return the verdict, the failing steps with the reason for each, the written report and links to the evidence. Pass testId to replay a saved test, or description to test anything in plain English, for example: "Sign up with a new email address and check that the dashboard opens and says Welcome." Waits for the verdict unless wait is false.

baseUrl.description: Run against this address instead of the project's own, for example a pull request's preview deployment. Must be publicly reachable.

description.description: What a visitor should do and what must be true at the end, in plain English. Name the buttons, fields and text as they appear on the page.

expectation.description: Use fail for a negative test (for example, a wrong password must be refused). Default pass.

projectId.description: Project id from list_projects. Optional when testId is given.

testId.description: A saved test id from list_tests.

timeoutSeconds.description: How long to wait for the verdict before returning the run as still in progress (default 600).

wait.description: Wait for the verdict (default true). With false, returns the run id at once; read it later with get_run.

name: run_test
title: Run a browser test
